errors.text_span: По хоризонталната ос са показани процентните стойности, които са измерени в проценти и са разпределени в равномерни интервали
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis shows percentage values at uniform intervals. The horizontal axis itself has no tick marks, labels, or a scale. The percentage values are provided as data labels next to each bar.

The description does not provide the specific text for any of the five categories (indicators), which is essential for understanding what the percentages refer to. It only mentions the "first indicator" and the "last one" without quoting their descriptions from the chart.
